rol_tizimli_kod.name: rol_tizimli_kod
rol_tizimli_kod.value: ("rol"."tizimli" = false AND "rol"."kod" IS NULL) OR ("rol"."tizimli" = true AND "rol"."kod" IS NOT NULL)

bolak_olcham_kerak.name: bolak_olcham_kerak
bolak_olcham_kerak.value:
("bolak"."turi" = 'DONA' AND "bolak"."miqdor" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("bolak"."turi" <> 'DONA' AND "bolak"."eni_m" IS NOT NULL AND "bolak"."boyi_m" IS NOT NULL)

bolak_olcham_musbat.name: bolak_olcham_musbat
bolak_olcham_musbat.value: ("bolak"."eni_m" IS NULL OR "bolak"."eni_m" > 0) AND ("bolak"."boyi_m" IS NULL OR "bolak"."boyi_m" > 0)

ombor_harakat_olchov.name: ombor_harakat_olchov
ombor_harakat_olchov.value: "ombor_harakat"."miqdor_kv_m" IS NOT NULL OR "ombor_harakat"."miqdor_sm" IS NOT NULL OR "ombor_harakat"."miqdor_dona" IS NOT NULL

mijoz_offset_toliq.name: mijoz_offset_toliq
mijoz_offset_toliq.value:
("mijoz"."offset_turi" IS NULL AND "mijoz"."offset_qiymat" IS NULL)
          OR ("mijoz"."offset_turi" IS NOT NULL AND "mijoz"."offset_qiymat" IS NOT NULL)

mijoz_yuridik_toliq.name: mijoz_yuridik_toliq
mijoz_yuridik_toliq.value:
"mijoz"."shaxs_turi" <> 'YURIDIK'
          OR ("mijoz"."tashkilot_nomi" IS NOT NULL AND "mijoz"."inn" IS NOT NULL
              AND "mijoz"."yuridik_manzil" IS NOT NULL)
